$comment: Exceptions to tools/check-interactions.ts, by page and control, each with its
reason. A control not named here must have a name a screen reader can
announce, take keyboard focus and show it, do something when pressed, answer
inside 300 ms under 4x CPU throttle, throw nothing and leave the page no wider
than a phone. The check reports an entry its control no longer needs.

button#sy-block \"run one 600ms task\".why: The demo is a 600 ms task: it blocks on purpose so scheduler.yield() has something to interrupt.

button.xp-button \"Cut\".why: The focusgroup demo's toolbar: the buttons exist to be arrowed between, and do nothing.

button.xp-button \"Copy\".why: The focusgroup demo's toolbar, as Cut.

button.xp-button \"Paste\".why: The focusgroup demo's toolbar, as Cut.

button.xp-button \"Delete\".why: The focusgroup demo's toolbar, as Cut.

button.xp-button \"label\".why: The align-content demo sets a <button> beside a <div> to compare how each centres its label. It is a specimen.

button#race \"Race 2,000 re-layouts\".why: The demo is the race: 2,000 DOM reflows on the main thread, timed against pretext doing the same layout without them.
